verdict.rationale: Runpod supports autonomous background execution via Serverless endpoints that scale workers up/down automatically (runpod-docs-25, runpod-docs-38), long-running processes on Pods via SSH (runpod-docs-6), and a REST/GraphQL API explicitly framed for 'applications, workflows, and automation systems' (runpod-docs-8, runpod-docs-63). However, there is no documented scheduler/cron/trigger system or dedicated 'automation' builder — users must wire up their own automation using the API/CLI rather than a first-party autonomous-automation feature. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/trigger mechanism, dedicated automation/workflow orchestration UI, independent evidence of long-running unattended jobs succeeding.
